what: Planned env-var docs describe fallback and tier clamping that the scripts do not implement
scenario_or_breakage: With LARCH_DESIGN_ROUND_CAP or LARCH_DESIGN_CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD set to a non-numeric value, SKILL.md passes that value as explicit argv and plan-review-loop.sh exits 2 instead of falling back; values above 5 are not clamped by the loop; convergence threshold 0 is accepted though the plan calls it positive
